module: Junction management of the Road Architect editor: pedestrian crossing, crossroads, T, Y, roundabout, rural/urban and highway/urban transitions, merges, separators, emergency lane fade and highway slip road. A junction is a record (name, type, ImGui parameters im.FloatPtr/IntPtr/BoolPtr, list of road names) whose roads are generated in roadMgr (editor/roadArchitect/roads) from profiles. The module can also move/rotate/copy/save/load a junction, finalize it (it becomes ordinary roads) and import a road network from the L-System tool. Editor-only (GE).
usage:
local j = extensions.editor_roadArchitect_junctions
j.addTJunction(true)            -- creates a T junction (last in the list)
local idx = #j.junctions
j.junctions[idx].numLanesX[0] = 2   -- ImGui parameter (pointer)
j.updateJunctionAfterChange(idx)  -- regenerates the roads
j.goToJunction(idx)
j.finaliseJunction(idx)         -- freezes the roads, removes the junction from the list
notes: A junction's parameters are ImGui pointers (im.FloatPtr, im.IntPtr, im.BoolPtr, im.ArrayChar): read/write with [0] and the name with ffi.string(jct.name).

Junction types recognized by updateJunctionAfterChange: crossing, crossroads, t-junction, y-junction, roundabout, rural_urban_transition, urban_merge, urban_separator, highway_merge, highway_urban_transition, highway_separator, shoulder_fade, highway_slip. Any other type is ignored (TODO comment in the code).

The addXxx(isNew) functions: with isNew=true they create a new record with default values; with isNew=false they reuse the last junction in the list (used by loadJunction after deserialiseJct). They then build the roads and call updateJunctionAfterChange(#junctions).

Probable bug: clearAllJunctions iterates forward with for i = 1, #junctions while calling removeJunction(i), which does table.remove; every other element is skipped and the #junctions bound is evaluated only once (risk of nil index). Avoid it or call it in a loop until the list is empty.
setAllMeshProperty does nothing useful: the loop fetches each road into a local variable r without modifying anything.
finaliseJunction does not delete the roads: it renames them (junction name + ' R' + n, or 'Overlay n'), sets isJctRoad = false, then only removes the record from the junctions list.
removeJunction deletes the junction's roads via roadMgr.removeRoad then the list entry.
The 'shoulder_fade' junction is handled by getJunctionCentroid/computeInitRot, but the centroid depends on jct.isY1Outwards[0].
Internal constant jctFlattenRad = 20 m (flattening radius around junctions, L-System).
importRoadsFromLSystem assumes two-way roads, one lane per direction, and ignores road_type (TODO comments in the code).

junctions.desc: List of junctions of the editing session (same table as the one used internally: modifications are visible on both sides). Each element contains at minimum name, type, roads (road names) and the condition parameters (condition, conditionSeed, numPatches, numPotholes).

getJunctionCentroid.desc: Computes the center of junction jIdx. The computation depends on the type: midpoint between a node of two roads (crossing, crossroads, t, y, roundabout, merges, slip), between the start and end of the 3rd road (transitions), last node of the 1st road (separators), or midpoint between the ends of two roads (shoulder_fade, depending on isY1Outwards). Returns nil for an unhandled type.

computeInitRot.desc: Computes the rotation angle around the junction's Z axis from the direction of its roads, relative to the X axis (util.getRotationBetweenVecs). Depends on the junction type.

returns.desc: Rotation returned by util.getRotationBetweenVecs (nil for an unhandled type).

updateJunctionCondition.desc: Propagates the junction's wear state (condition, seed, number of patches and potholes) to all its non-overlay roads, then calls profileMgr.updateCondition. The roads' patches and potholes are 15% (rounded up) of the junction's values; the seed is shifted by one rank per road.

updateJunctionAfterChange.desc: Empties roadMgr.multi then regenerates the junction's roads according to its type after a parameter change, and reapplies the pavement condition.

addPedXJunction.desc: Adds a 2-way pedestrian crossing junction (crossing + traffic lights only), type 'crossing'.

isNew.desc: true: creates a new default record; false: reuses the last junction in the list.

isNew.desc: true: new default record; false: reuses the last junction.

isNew.desc: true: new default record; false: reuses the last junction.

addHighwaySlipJunction.desc: Adds a highway slip road, type 'highway_slip'.

isNew.desc: true: new default record; false: reuses the last junction.

removeJunction.desc: Deletes the junction's roads (roadMgr.removeRoad) then the entry in the junctions list.

clearAllJunctions.desc: Tries to delete all junctions by calling removeJunction(i) in an ascending loop. See notes: the loop modifies the list during iteration.

translateJunction.desc: Translates all nodes of all the junction's roads by the given vector and marks the roads as modified (roadMgr.setDirty).

rotateJunction.desc: Rotates the junction around the Z axis through cen, by angle theta; the z height of the nodes is preserved.

rotateJunctionQuat.desc: Rotates all the junction's nodes around cen according to quaternion q (util.rotateVecByQuaternion).

goToJunction.desc: Places the free camera above the junction, looking down, at a height that fits the whole junction in the field of view (computed with the core_camera FOV). Does nothing if the bounding box is smaller than 0.1 m.

setAllMeshProperty.desc: Meant to make all the junction's roads use (or not use) meshes, but the body modifies nothing (see notes).

updateJunctionsAfterRoadRemove.desc: Removes from the list the junctions for which at least one road no longer exists in roadMgr. To be called after a road is deleted.

finaliseJunction.desc: Finalizes the junction: renames its roads (junction name + ' R' + n, or 'Overlay n' for overlays), marks them as normal roads (isJctRoad = false), then removes the junction from the list. The roads remain in the editor.

copyJunction.desc: Deep-copies a junction (new ImGui pointers, road list duplicated with deepcopy).

serialiseJct.desc: Converts a junction to a plain table, without ImGui pointers (values read with [0], name with ffi.string), ready to be written as JSON. Note: the roads list is shared, not copied.

deserialiseJct.desc: Inverse operation of serialiseJct: rebuilds a junction record with its ImGui pointers from a table read from JSON; some missing values get a default (for example arrowMat).

saveJunction.desc: Opens the save dialog (editor_fileDialog) then writes a JSON containing the serialized junction (name = file name), its position (centroid) and its initial rotation.

loadJunction.desc: Opens the open dialog (editor_fileDialog), reads the JSON, deserializes the junction, adds it to the list then regenerates its roads with the addXxx(false) function matching its type.

chopRoadsToSphere.desc: For each listed road, removes the nodes located inside the sphere (circle in 2D) and projects the first or last node onto the circle, depending on whether the road touches the junction by its start ('start') or its end.

jNodes.desc: Road ends concerned: rName = road name, lie = 'start' or 'end'.

createAutoJctOverlays.desc: Automatically creates overlay roads between the roads arriving at the same junction (in pairs, depending on the start/end cases), from the roads' render data. No comment in the code; description inferred from code.

jNodes.desc: Road ends of the junction (rName, lie = 'start' or 'end').

laneWidth.desc: Lane width, in meters (inferred from code).

jctCen.desc: Junction center (its z height is used).

importRoadsFromLSystem.desc: Imports a road network from the L-System tool: creates one Road Architect road per unique road (1 lane per direction profile, width from the import), then for each intersection cuts the roads at the sphere of the given radius and creates the junction overlays. If doTerraform is true, then terraforms the terrain under the whole network.

roadNetwork.desc: Indexed unique roads; each element has id, type, width, splineNodes (with pos) and nodes (with id).

intersections.desc: Intersections keyed by node id; each element has connectedRoads, radius and pos.

DOI.desc: Parameter passed to terra.terraformMultiRoads (domain of influence, inferred from code).

doTerraform.desc: true to terraform the terrain after the import.
